answer_field: text (re-segmented) — 理's ruling (iii); text_raw is never trained on
why_valid_comes_out_of_train: mlx-lm requires valid.jsonl; the held-out 33 are reserved for the judge and the P4 probes, so the only place left is the train split. It costs 7 of 70.
thinness: 63 training examples. This is thin and it belongs in the row, not only in the prose: any P2/P3 effect has to be read against it.
